meta.title: Radic Forma — 3D models and laser engraving
meta.description: Radic Forma designs and makes 3D printed objects and laser engravings on wood, acrylic, leather and metal. Where matter comes to life.

brand.lockup.alt: Radic Forma — Where matter comes to life

scena.testo: The mark is first laser engraved onto the surface of a log, line after line, then rebuilt layer upon layer by the nozzle of a 3D printer. It is the most direct way to show what we do: removing material and adding it, with the same precision.
scena.alternativa: A sequence in three moments: the Radic Forma monogram laser engraved onto a log section, the shift in perspective from top-down to three-quarter view, and the same monogram 3D printed layer by layer on a build plate.
scena.didascalia1: Laser engraving — line-by-line scan on wood
scena.didascalia2: Shift in perspective — from plane to volume

servizi.testo: Three ways of working matter, often combined in the same object.

uno.testo: Home and kitchen accessories, organisers, functional pieces. From short runs to one-offs, printed in FDM and finished by hand.

due.testo: Marking, personalisation and precision cutting on wood, acrylic, leather and anodised metal. Text, logos, graphic patterns and serial numbering.

tre.testo: We start from a sketch, a measurement or a practical problem and get to the production file. Modelling, dimensional checks and a test print.

tecnologie.testo: We work with two complementary technologies: fused deposition printing, which builds the object layer by layer, and the laser, which engraves and cuts by removing material. The choice depends on the material, the tolerance required and the number of pieces.

stampa.testo: Bambu Lab printers with heated bed and automatic filament changing for multicolour prints.

laser.testo: Raster engraving and vector cutting, with power and speed tuned to each material.

materiali.testo: Every material behaves differently: wood darkens, acrylic frosts, anodised aluminium lightens. On request we prepare a sample before production.
materiali.nota: Other materials on request, subject to a workability test.

uno.testo: You tell us what you need, even with a sketch or a photo. We assess feasibility, materials and timing.

due.testo: We prepare the 3D model or vector file and show you a preview before production.

tre.testo: We print or engrave, with a test piece whenever the material calls for one.

quattro.testo: Hand finishing, final inspection and shipping, or collection in person.

contatti.testo: Write to us with a description, a measurement or a reference photo: we reply with a feasibility assessment and a quote.
contatti.nota: We reply within [to be confirmed] working days.
